SELECT sku, gtin, name, pack, case_units, case_kg, flow, dc_slot, price_inr, cost_inr
FROM store.products
WHERE name ILIKE '%atta%' OR pack ILIKE '%5 kg%'
ORDER BY sku;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS source, date::text AS ts, units_sold::text AS value1, revenue_inr::text AS value2, NULL::text AS extra
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', audit_ts::text, status, NULL, NULL
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', date::text, book_on_hand_close::text, NULL, NULL
FROM store.inventory_book
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', date::text, forecast_units_per_day::text, sigma::text,
       'rop=' || reorder_point || ',out=' || order_up_to || ',book=' || book_on_hand || ',on_order=' || on_order || ',ordered=' || ordered_units
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', count_ts::text, book_before::text, counted::text, 'adjustment=' || adjustment || ',trigger=' || trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND count_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND count_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'

SELECT 'write_offs', date::text, units::text, reason, NULL
FROM store.write_offs

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_units,
  (SELECT SUM(revenue_inr) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_revenue,
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_units,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS first_sales_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS last_sales_date,
  (SELECT MAX(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS last_pos_ts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS june_audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status = 'on shelf' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS on_shelf_audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status = 'empty' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS empty_audits;

SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, d.revenue_inr, f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma,
       i.book_on_hand_close,
       a.audit_ts, a.status AS shelf_status,
       GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - d.units_sold, 0) AS forecast_shortfall_units
FROM store.daily_sales d
JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku = d.sku AND f.date = d.date
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.sku = d.sku AND i.date = d.date
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku = d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date = d.date
WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT bill_ts::date AS sales_date, bill_ts, bill_id, line, qty, unit_price, line_amount
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND ((bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-07' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-14')
    OR (bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-21' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-28'))
ORDER BY bill_ts, bill_id, line;

SELECT 'pos_payments' AS source, note, COUNT(*) AS rows

GROUP BY note
UNION ALL
SELECT 'customer_complaints', kind || ' | ' || COALESCE(resolution, ''), COUNT(*)
FROM payments.customer_complaints
GROUP BY kind, resolution
UNION ALL
SELECT 'goods_receipts', receipt_method, COUNT(*)
FROM store.goods_receipts
GROUP BY receipt_method
ORDER BY source, note;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS dataset, MIN(date)::text AS start_date, MAX(date)::text AS end_date, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS skus
FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku)
FROM store.forecasts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku)
FROM store.inventory_book
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku)
FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines', MIN(bill_ts)::text, MAX(bill_ts)::text, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku_scanned)
FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'products', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku)
FROM store.products
ORDER BY dataset;

SELECT
  SUM(units_sold) AS june_units,
  SUM(revenue_inr) AS june_revenue,
  COUNT(*) AS recorded_days,
  MIN(date) AS first_recorded_day,
  MAX(date) AS last_recorded_day,
  SUM(CASE WHEN units_sold = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_sale_days
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';

SELECT 'order' AS event_type, so.created_ts::text AS event_time, so.order_id AS ref1,
       so.units::text AS units, so.cases::text AS cases, so.reason AS note
FROM store.store_orders so
WHERE so.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'receipt', gr.received_ts::text, gr.grn_id || '/' || gr.shipment_id || '/' || gr.sscc,
       gr.units_booked::text, gr.asn_units::text,
       'asn_sku=' || gr.asn_sku || '; booked=' || gr.sku_booked
FROM store.goods_receipts gr
WHERE gr.sku_booked = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' OR gr.asn_sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'asn', sn.shipment_id, sn.sscc || '/line ' || sn.line || '/order ' || sn.order_id,
       sn.units::text, sn.cases::text, 'sku=' || sn.sku || '; gtin=' || sn.gtin
FROM warehouse.shipping_notice_lines sn
WHERE sn.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY event_type, event_time;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_shelf_audit_pct,
  MIN(audit_ts) AS first_audit,
  MAX(audit_ts) AS last_audit
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day,
         a.status AS audit_status
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  JOIN store.forecasts f
    ON f.sku = d.sku AND f.date = d.date
  LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a
    ON a.sku = d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date = d.date
  WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(forecast_units_per_day), 2) AS forecast_units_all_recorded_days,
  SUM(units_sold) AS actual_units_all_recorded_days,
  ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day - units_sold, 0)), 2) AS positive_shortfall_all_days,
  ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day - units_sold, 0)) * 265, 2) AS positive_shortfall_value_all_days,
  ROUND(SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0), 2) AS forecast_on_zero_sale_days,
  ROUND(SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0) * 265, 2) AS forecast_value_on_zero_sale_days,
  ROUND(SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'empty'), 2) AS forecast_on_audited_empty_days,
  ROUND(SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'empty') * 265, 2) AS forecast_value_on_audited_empty_days
FROM daily;

SELECT p.sku, p.name,
       COUNT(a.*) AS audits,
       COUNT(a.*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
       STRING_AGG(a.audit_ts::date || ':' || a.status, ', ' ORDER BY a.audit_ts) AS audit_trail,
       SUM(d.units_sold) AS units_sold,
       SUM(d.units_sold = 0)::int AS zero_sale_days
FROM store.products p
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku = p.sku
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.sku = p.sku
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name
ORDER BY p.sku;
